findings.label: Stale not-serviceable flash on PIN re-check
findings.detail: Switching from one unserviceable PIN to another briefly shows the old 'This PIN code is not serviceable.' message until the new check resolves, because use-pincode.ts resets serviceable to null only when pincode becomes falsy, not on a value change. Lives in the unmodified hook and self-corrects; optional fix is to clear local state on submit or reset serviceable in the hook.

findings.label: No focus trap on modal overlay
findings.detail: The gate sets role=dialog and aria-modal=true and blocks pointer interaction, but does not trap keyboard focus, so a tabbing user can reach the storefront behind the overlay. Minor a11y gap, not a functional bypass of the mandatory flow for normal usage.
